governance_implication: Use as national association/member-network authority, not statutory registry.

observed_fact: BookHub founded in 2023 by BooksellersNZ; brings together shelves of over 70 independent bookshops; user sees which member bookshops have stock and then goes to store.
governance_implication: BookHub is an inventory-commerce overlay; stock rows become observations linked to store entities.

observed_fact: BookHub product/category pages expose stock counts and Find Store signals.
